messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，途經費城、華盛頓特區和亞特蘭大，最後抵達邁阿密，預計的旅行時間會是多少？另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接從華盛頓特區前往邁阿密，會是多少時間？最後，如果我從改成從費城出發，停留華盛頓特區，然後抵達邁阿密，會是多少時間？

function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey ordered.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "If I start from New York, pass through Philadelphia, Washington DC and Atlanta, finally reach Miami, what is the estimated travel time? Also if I don't stop in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami, how long? Finally, if I change to start from Philadelphia, stop at Washington DC, then reach Miami, how long?" They want estimates. We have a tool route_estimate_time. We need to call it three times.

First scenario: start_location="New York", end_location="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington DC","Atlanta"].

Second scenario: start_location="New York", end_location="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington DC"] (no Atlanta). Actually they said "directly from Washington DC to Miami" but still passing through Philadelphia? They didn't mention Philadelphia in second scenario. They said "if I don't stop in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami". That implies stops: ["Philadelphia","Washington DC"]. So we include Philadelphia as well. Or maybe they mean skip Atlanta only. So stops: ["Philadelphia","Washington DC"].

Third scenario: start_location="Philadelphia", end_location="Miami", stops=["Washington DC"].

We need to call the function each time. Use the function calls. Then respond with results. Let's do that.
